# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- For PDF export, voided/ΑΚΥΡΟ CLIP rows should be 16 pt normally and grow to 24 pt only when a voided camera has a roll-change number to print.
- In voided camera cells, place the roll-change number above the ΑΚΥΡΟ CLIP label. Roll-change numbers on other cameras in the same voided row should remain visible over the cross-stitch or no-roll cell marks.
